_comment: v3.66.1230 row-197 battery. This gate's fix and its tests live in the SAME file, so replaying the tests on the parent tree cannot be RED -- the widened denominator travels with them. The battery IS the provenance: each mutant removes one part of the population contract and a named catcher must fail. Recorded rather than glossed. FIRST RUN: 2 caught, 3 ESCAPED, and all three escapes were real holes. Nothing drove the single-string spawn form, nothing forced an empty population (the real repository is never empty, so the refusal could not fire), and nothing made a declared exemption go stale. Three catchers were added for them.
